name: Badass Animal Rescue (Badass Brooklyn)
neighborhoods: Brooklyn-based; adopts to NY/NJ/CT/PA/Upstate NY (home visit required)
notes: 501(c)(3) since 2011 (founder Sara Alize Cross); 4,000+ dogs rehomed. All-breed, all-volunteer, foster-based - no physical shelter. Pulls the most at-risk dogs from overcrowded rural shelters in the US South and US Virgin Islands, transports to NYC-area foster homes. Adopters must be 23+, provide ID + references, consent to a home visit. Mailing: 419 McDonald Ave, Box 180523, Brooklyn NY 11218.
